summary: An equation-blind shortcut answers all five delivered batch questions. Five legacy inventory records also retain fixed-sign shortcuts. Other checks pass; package files are unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Translate naturally ordered linear equations into coefficient or augmented matrices.
reasoning_steps: Read signed coefficients into columns while preserving equation order as rows.
Append right-hand constants for an augmented matrix.
invariants: Easy questions use two already organized integer equations in two variables.
One correct radio selection among five matrices.
No solving or row reduction is required.
permitted_variations: Vary coefficients, signs, constants and implicit units.
Vary supported variable names and answer positions.
Vary which eligible bank member matches the displayed equations, recomputing prompts, keys and solutions.

findings.description: All five delivered questions can be answered without reading their equations: select the two-row prefix of an extra-zero-row option; otherwise select the first singleton coefficient sign found while scanning the first column top to bottom. Native grading accepts all five selections. The same rule succeeds on only 24/96 applicable control records, distinguishing this batch failure from a universal generator defect.
